newsitem.title: USA: Flag Financial unit sees Q3 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Flag Financial unit sees Q3 net loss.

text.p: FLAG Financial Corp said on Friday its wholly owned subsidiary, First Federal Savings Bank of LaGrange, expects a third-quarter net loss.

The company said the loss is a result of a $2.3 million charge against earnings in the third quarter related to a portfolio of equipment leases sold to the Bank through the Bennett Funding Group Inc and loans serviced by a Bennett affiliate.

Bennett Funding Group recently filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, leading Flag to make a reserve of $3 million. The company said that future collections with regard to these equipment leases, totaling $4.5 million, are doubtful, and that the loans serviced by the Bennett affiliate totaling $5 million should be classified as substandard.
